title: WabbleSpec Extension Platform Receipt
description: Extends base receipt schema for Extension/Plugin platform activation and gate verification.

extension_type.description: Specific extension type detected by Recipe

manifest_version.description: Browser extension manifest version (2 or 3). MV2 triggers migration flag.

permissions_declared.description: All permissions declared in manifest — must be minimal

csp_declared.description: Content Security Policy explicitly declared in manifest

mv3_migration_flagged.description: Set to true if manifest_version is 2 — migration to MV3 required

verification_gates_failed.description: Gate IDs that failed. Must be empty before Delivery wave.
